Task: CaSiO3 bulk minimisation for Surface Energy
Description: Given paths to LAMMPs-compatible wollastonite CaSiO3 structure file and a ReaxFF potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of CaSiO3 based on given simulation parameters. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in kcal/mol
